content_of_post_to_answer: Can overthinking affect your physical health?
answer: Overthinking affects health not because thoughts are inherently harmful, but because the body often reacts to imagined threats as if they are happening. A mind repeatedly running worst-case scenarios can keep stress systems activated, affecting sleep, digestion, tension, and energy. The overlooked distinction is between reflection, which helps you solve problems, and rumination, which makes you relive them without resolution. A thought becomes unhealthy when it stops guiding action and starts consuming attention.
